description: Implementation of AVDTP Signal serialization and deserialization for Bluetooth audio, including packet handling and error management.

classes.name: Signal
classes.description: Handles serialization and deserialization of AVDTP signaling packets, managing fragmentation, packet types, and error states.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Serializes the signal into a stream, handling fragmentation and packet headers.

methods.name: Deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes a stream into a signal, managing packet reassembly and error detection.
